title: Ledger
tagline: Personal finance: budgets, savings goals and an emergency fund
description: A mobile-first money tracker with net worth, accounts, monthly budgets, savings goals and an emergency-fund target. Transactions go in through a validated form, and every chart and budget updates instantly.
features: Bottom tab bar and swipeable add sheet on phones
Add-transaction form with React Hook Form and Zod
Budgets that say over or under in words, not just color
Savings goals with progress, quick amounts and confetti
Net worth trend, spending chart and sparkline stats
Transactions table on desktop, grouped list on phones
